name: capture_browser_scenario
description: Run a controlled browser scenario when passive observation cannot exercise the application. Launch the selected executable or connect to a loopback CDP target, provide a start URL and actions, and select storage or artifacts when needed. A request action sends one HTTP request to the start origin through the page's own fetch, with header values from secrets, page cookies or local storage; write methods change application state. Environment, empty storage, a URL-only final capture, and measured event-retention budgets are defaults. capture.network selects request_body, response_body, and header_values independently; capture.limits lets callers raise or lower the event count, retained-allocation estimates, network transaction count, and network content budgets. Selected content is returned inline with transaction and event references, byte digests, and explicit unavailable states. Budget omissions identify affected event kinds and network transactions. Credentials and declared secrets are redacted. Agents can run their own local fixture servers to control application responses. Actions run until completion or cancellation unless timeout_ms is set. Default detail complete returns the capture inline. Detail summary retains complete Evidence and returns step outcomes, the final or first unsuccessful step’s accessibility tree, and event/network counts. Read exact steps with selected artifacts, UTF-16 text pages, transactions with opt-in content, or events filtered by step, kind and transaction, through inspect_analysis_view kind browser-scenario.

parameters.description: Advertised in reduced form by the compact input schema profile; the server still validates complete canonical inputs.

actions.description: Required sequence of explicit browser actions.

browser.description: Required launch/connect selection. Launch uses the selected executable and an owned temporary profile; connect uses one loopback CDP endpoint and target.

capture.description: Optional retained artifacts and event families. Defaults to only a final sanitized URL; request screenshots, DOM, accessibility, history, storage, and event capture explicitly.

command_timeout_ms.description: CDP WebSocket handshake and per-command response deadline in milliseconds (default 20000). Omitted means 20000 and applies on the next call. deadlineExpired for a handshake or command is not the caller observation window, not the CDP discovery deadline (default 10000 ms, or discovery_timeout_ms where supported), and not the 5000 ms cleanup grace. It also bounds passive script-source collection and the inspection/source-join phase that share this deadline. Does not raise the fixed protocol, retained-event, or source byte budgets, or the cleanup grace, which have no runtime override.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.

environment.description: Optional deterministic browser settings. Defaults to 1280x720, en-US, UTC, light mode, reduced motion, and blocked service workers.

secrets.description: Optional environment-variable references for values used in actions, URLs, storage, or replay, and for redacting matching observed text. Secret values are never supplied inline.

start_url.description: Required initial HTTP(S) URL. Query values must be declared separately as public literals or secret references.

storage.description: Optional initial cookies, local storage, or session storage. Defaults to empty; every supplied value and origin must be declared and within the allowed origins.
